decks.notes: This deck focuses on board control and building up resources to overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Up the Beanstalk and Invasion of Zendikar to ramp up mana, the player can quickly play powerful creatures like Archangel of Wrath and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. Leyline Binding and Spara's Headquarters help to control the opponent's board while Ziatora's Proving Ground and Topiary Stomper provide additional threats. The deck also includes some removal with Depopulate and offers some protection with cards like Boseiju, Who Endures. Ultimately, the goal is to maintain board dominance and outvalue the opponent.

This Rakdos Control deck focuses on board control and removal, utilizing cards like Burn Down the House and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. It also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using cards like Sheoldred's Edict and Virtue of Persistence. The deck can also generate card advantage and mana acceleration through Breach the Multiverse and The Celestus. The high-value threats like Archfiend of the Dross and Etali, Primal Conqueror can quickly close out the game once the opponent's resources are depleted.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of creature removal, land manipulation, and powerful spells. The key strategy is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Herd Migration and Up the Beanstalk, while also locking down opponents with Leyline Binding and Archangel of Wrath. The win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Topiary Stomper, while also using cards like Sunfall and Invasion of Zendikar to maintain board control. Additionally, the deck utilizes Cavern of Souls and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect key creatures and spells from counters.

The main concept of this Azorius Aggro deck is to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy. The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures like Zephyr Sentinel and Lunarch Veteran to quickly build a board presence. Make Disappear and Fortified Beachhead provide control options while Resolute Reinforcements and Knight-Errant of Eos offer ways to buff and protect your creatures. Additionally, cards like Malcolm, Alluring Scoundrel and Recruitment Officer provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck aims to close out games swiftly before opponents have a chance to stabilize.

This Esper Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's strategy. It includes cards that can quickly build a board presence and apply pressure, such as Faerie Mastermind and Deep-Cavern Bat. Additionally, the deck contains control elements like Cut Down and Make Disappear to handle threats and protect key cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells allows this deck to create a fast-paced and versatile strategy, overwhelming opponents with a mix of aggression and disruption.

The main focus of this Orzhov Control deck is to utilize a variety of cards to control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy. With cards like Farewell, Destroy Evil, and Lay Down Arms, you can remove threats from your opponent's side of the field. Cards like The Restoration of Eiganjo and Clay-Fired Bricks allow you to protect your own creatures and gain advantage. The deck also includes strong finishers like Elspeth Resplendent and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver your opponent through careful resource management and strategic play.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures and removal spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By combining aggressive creatures like Trumpeting Carnosaur and Deep-Cavern Bat with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, the deck aims to control the board while dealing damage efficiently. Cards like The Cruelty of Gix and Anoint with Affliction provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while the lands in the deck ensure a smooth mana base for casting spells consistently. Overall, this deck aims to win through fast and aggressive gameplay.

The focus of this deck is to control the board through a combination of removal spells and artifacts that provide efficient creature removal and disruption. The deck aims to stall the opponent's game plan while establishing its own win conditions, such as Depopulate, Glass Casket, and The Irencrag. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Thousand Moons Smithy and Thran Spider to further control the battlefield. By utilizing a mix of artifact creatures and spells, this UW Control deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a 1 vs 1 match.

This deck focuses on establishing control over the battlefield through a combination of creature removal, land manipulation, and powerful creatures. By utilizing cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Leyline Binding, it aims to restrict the opponent's options while building up its own board presence with creatures like Archangel of Wrath. The deck also includes cards like Invasion of Zendikar and Sunfall to generate additional resources and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the strategy revolves around maintaining board control and overwhelming the opponent with efficient threats.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming and pressuring the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and removal spells. The key strategy involves establishing early board presence with efficient threats like Deep-Cavern Bat and Dennick, Pious Apprentice, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Make Disappear. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Raffine, Scheming Seer to maintain board control and push for a quick victory. Wedding Announcement and Virtue of Loyalty provide additional support and resilience to help secure the win.

This deck focuses on utilizing a mix of aggro creatures and removal spells to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the board state. The goal is to establish a dominant early game presence with aggressive creatures like Regal Bunnicorn and Spyglass Siren, while also having access to removal spells like Destroy Evil and Make Disappear to deal with threats from the opponent. The deck also includes cards that provide additional value, such as Wedding Announcement and Warden of the Inner Sky, to further enhance the aggressive strategy. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive Azorius creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and control the battlefield. By combining powerful creatures like Regal Bunnicorn and Warden of the Inner Sky with disruptive spells like Protect the Negotiators and Invasion of Segovia, the deck aims to establish board presence and maintain control throughout the game. The inclusion of utility lands like Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire and Restless Anchorage further enhances the deck's versatility and ability to adapt to different situations.

The key concept of this Orzhov Control deck is to maintain control of the game by using a combination of creature removal, board wipes, and disruption spells. The deck utilizes cards like Destroy Evil, Lay Down Arms, and Get Lost to remove threats from the opponent's board and disrupt their plans. It also includes cards like Treasure Map and Sunfall to generate card advantage and mana ramp. With a mix of powerful creatures like The Wandering Emperor and Serra Paragon, as well as utility lands like Field of Ruin, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent's life total using aggressive creatures and burn spells. The strategy involves playing low-cost creatures like Phoenix Chick and Bloodthirsty Adversary, while also using powerful burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire to remove any blockers or deal direct damage. The inclusion of cards like Squee, Dubious Monarch and Goddric, Cloaked Reveler provide additional value and resilience to the deck. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats and burn spells to secure a quick victory.

This Orzhov Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Get Lost and Lay Down Arms while building up its own resources with Treasure Map and Clay-Fired Bricks. The deck also has a strong removal package with cards like The Restoration of Eiganjo and Breach the Multiverse. The creatures in the deck, such as Serra Paragon and Ao, the Dawn Sky, provide additional value and threats to the opponent. The deck aims to control the game through a combination of removal, disruption, and powerful creatures to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent.

This deck focuses on using a combination of evasive creatures and disruptive spells to apply pressure on the opponent and tempo out the game. By playing aggressive creatures like Bloodletter of Aclazotz and Spyglass Siren, while also using countermagic like Spell Pierce and removal like Go for the Throat, the deck aims to control the board while chipping away at the opponent's life total. Additionally, the inclusion of card draw engines like Malcolm, Alluring Scoundrel and Faerie Mastermind helps the deck maintain card advantage and keep up the pressure on the opponent.
